name: agentready
description: Agent Ready: audit and fix whether an AI agent can reach, understand, act on and complete a transaction on a website.

plugins.name: agentready
plugins.description: Raise a website's Agent Ready score. Scans with the Agent Ready audit, maps every finding to a concrete edit, applies what is safe, and hands off what needs infrastructure or a business decision. Works on codebases (Next, Astro, Nuxt, Hono, static) and on WordPress sites with no repo access, by generating a drop-in plugin.
